# Codex Context Monitor

> An unofficial Windows context window and token usage monitor for the OpenAI Codex desktop app. Shows context usage, estimated tokens per second, prompt cache hit rate, per-model cumulative tokens, and estimated API token cost. 中文：Windows Codex 上下文窗口、Token 用量、缓存命中率与 API 费用估算悬浮窗。

## Documentation

- [English README](https://github.com/Cand1ePower/codex-context-monitor/blob/main/README.md): Features, copyable installation prompt for a local coding agent, settings, metric definitions, compatibility, and tests.
- [中文说明](https://github.com/Cand1ePower/codex-context-monitor/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 中文功能、Agent 安装提示词、设置、统计口径及常见问题。
- [Latest release](https://github.com/Cand1ePower/codex-context-monitor/releases/latest): Installable source ZIP and SHA-256 checksum.
- [Pricing data](https://github.com/Cand1ePower/codex-context-monitor/blob/main/pricing.json): Supported models, official source URLs, and rate check date.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/Cand1ePower/codex-context-monitor/issues): Compatibility reports and bugs.

## Technical facts

- Platform: Windows 10/11; Windows PowerShell 5.1, WPF, and Python 3.10+ standard library.
- Type: A separate desktop overlay; not a native input-bar extension or a Codex CLI statusline.
- Install: Inspect and run Install.ps1 from the latest release. The application installs per user under %LOCALAPPDATA%\CodexContextMonitor\app.
- Lifecycle: Launch.vbs starts a hidden watcher. The overlay and reader start with the Codex window and stop when it closes. Quit.ps1 stops the monitor and watcher; Uninstall.ps1 also removes its managed Startup entry.
- Language: Defaults to auto; Windows Chinese display languages use zh-CN, other display languages use en-US. settings.json accepts explicit language overrides.
- Display: Collapsed to a small status bar by default. Click the ring or metrics to open the details panel; click outside to close it.
- Data: Reads local Codex logs, thread index, and usage records. No API key, model call, or chat upload.
- Speed: Last-response estimate including reasoning, updated when usage records arrive; not instantaneous token streaming.
- Cost: Per-response API token estimate, not a subscription bill. Unknown models or tiers remain unpriced. See pricing.json for freshness and coverage.
- Compatibility: Internal local log formats can change. Tested against Windows Codex 26.1027.51404. Cloud-only chats without local usage records cannot be priced.
